text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(It was as if the passage of time itself
slowed to a
crawl.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Come oooon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (At this rate... Ngh!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I committed my heart and soul to that
race, and
as I ran, I felt nothing else but
a desperate desire
to win.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (And in the very moment that desire reached its apex, I heard that sound...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I want to win... I want to win!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to defeat Yaeno and Chiyono O, right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crrrrack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The sound of... glass cracking? Are my
legs...
broken?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No, this is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (It's the sound of me shattering my limits, right now!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro Ardan has
crossed the finish line! The daughter of
the Mejiro family has
claimed first place
at the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What a fantastic race that was. Everyone
racing
out there today... They really
shined.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! Mejiro Ardan, you were
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That race was wicked!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I had no idea! To think that the heat of
the race
plays home to such a dazzling
world of
possibilities!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And that being able to set foot into
that world
and surpass my limits there...
took more than my
efforts alone...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Your running, your drive, and your
hunger for victory... They were all
shining beacons of light
that opened up
the gates holding me back.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...The way you ran—it was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! I really, really mean it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for such kind words.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I admit my defeat. But...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Know that this is not the end. The next
time we
compete... I will emerge
victorious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It would be my honor to compete with
you again.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As was the case today, I will have no
intention of relinquishing victory when
next we meet. I shall
compete with
everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I would not have it any other way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. And your name, too.
choice_data_list: You've etched your name into history.
You've etched your name into history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The titles of Derby champion and Derby
trainer...
Our moment has been
immortalized here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...The pleasure is all mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer, from the bottom of
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Mejiro Ardan! You'd give
Mejiro
Ramonu a run for her money!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Oh, that's right... Up until now, I...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I forgot all about surpassing my older
sister...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thunderous applause and cheering
continue. Then, as Mejiro Ardan and I
make our way back
to the waiting
room...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I had an experience most peculiar at
the race
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I neared the finish line, an unfamiliar
sensation
welled up inside, as if the
whole world was falling
still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the silence, I could hear two
things very clearly—Chiyono O and
Yaeno's heartbeats, and
the sound of
their feet hitting the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With that rhythm drawing me in... I saw
the gates holding me back—my own
limits—and I opened them. I took my
first steps into the new world
beyond...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The sensation I felt in that moment—that
there
existed even greater
heights—lingers in my hands
even now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And there was something else...
Something that
took even me by
surprise...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It was only a moment ago that I finally

remembered... my goal to outshine my
older
sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Giving my all... with my rivals...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes... You're quite right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Those two are my dearest friends... and
my
toughest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And not only that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's because I competed with everything I could muster—to the point that I forgot about my older sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And because they gave that race everything they had too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That I was able to shine even brighter
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always striven to seize the moment
with her
running, so today's discovery
will likely change
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And it'll change me too.
I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan's legs carry her to
a new
world of possibilities!
